entries.evidence: The two treads are one submodel (42042 - technicChainTread38Closed-1.ldr, 45 links of 57518 round six circles), placed twice in the main model, at x 210 and x -210. The one at x 210 is at z 60, and each of its six circles is on its wheel's axle (the two sprockets 57519 and the four rollers). The one at x -210 is at z 70, so each of its circles lies 10 LDU along the crawler from its axle, and it is read round no wheel (functions 2 and 9 fail as track-not-read). The booklet fits both treads the same way, each centred on its sprockets (page 54, https://www.lego.com/cdn/product-assets/product.bi.core.pdf/6151636.pdf#page=54: 90 links, 2 × 45). Placed at z 60, as the other one is, its six circles are on their axles.
